connector.name: Airflow
connector.registryDescription: Airflow MCP - list DAGs/runs/task instances, tail logs, trigger and clear (write-gated)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package airflow-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the us-all account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AIRFLOW_API_URL
env.description: Airflow host base, e.g. 'http://airflow.example.com:8080'. Server prepends /api/v2 internally; trailing /api/v1 or /api/v2 is stripped if supplied.

env.name: AIRFLOW_USERNAME
env.description: Airflow username (used to mint a JWT via SimpleAuthManager /auth/token).

env.name: AIRFLOW_PASSWORD
env.description: Airflow password (used to mint a JWT via SimpleAuthManager /auth/token).

env.name: AIRFLOW_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable trigger-dag and clear-task tools. Default read-only.
